title: Extension of T to compactly supported continuous coefficient fields (parent step 2)
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (d : ℕ) (c : Covector (Euclid P) n ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), IsOpen U → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → T.massOn W < ∞) → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm α = ‖c α‖) → ∃ L : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap U (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, (∀ (ω : TestFormOn U n) (g : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap U (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))), (∀ x : U, g x = c ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x)) → L g = T ω) ∧ ∀ K : Set U, IsCompact K → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ g : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap U (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), tsupport g ⊆ K → (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ 1) → |L g| ≤ M
